claim.summary: ILO field research documented debt bondage among predominantly Indigenous workers in the Santa Cruz sugar harvest and northern Amazon Brazil-nut harvest, and extreme forms of forced labour in isolated captive communities in the Bolivian Chaco. The atlas records a bounded 2004 debt-bondage claim across those researched settings without treating Bolivia as uniformly affected.
